analysis_method: Claude visual inspection of the full image

structural_characteristics.layout: Eight numbered section cards in a two-column/full-width grid, read in number order top to bottom.
structural_characteristics.reading_direction: Left-to-right, top-to-bottom by numbered titles; no inter-section connectors.
patterns: numbered pastel section cards with tab titles

design_characteristics.color_treatment: Each section a different soft pastel tint with matching tab.
design_characteristics.typography: Bold sans title with lighter second word; clear small sans labels.
design_characteristics.containers: Rounded pastel cards, soft shadows, pill chips.
design_characteristics.connectors: Only short local arrows inside sections.

content_capacity.observed: Many chips and short text lines legible.

limitations: No pattern for cross-section flow or hub convergence.
uncertainties: Exact pastel values and fonts not measured.

evidence.observation: Chip grid feeding a small tree and an inline arrow flow.
Three side-by-side sub-cards with chip clusters.

content_isolation: Reference text, names, logos, claims and creator branding are not carried into this run; only layout/design patterns are profiled.
